material.acceptance_criteria: CI job loads a mod, edits one value, reloads, and observes the new value in the next tick; a deliberately broken reload leaves the previous value in effect and reports the error; gate reports 0 failed on ubuntu, macos and windows.
material.description: Reload .star and Lua mod files while the server keeps ticking. Validate the new version off the tick path; on failure keep the last good version and report the error. Rust crate rust/crates/mod-host owns this.
material.resolution: Hot reload validates off tick and swaps at boundary, failed reload keeps last good and reports ReloadError with file, line, message. CI harness reload_harness proves value change on next tick, error reported with line, rollback held; closes unknowns U1 to U4. Basename fix for mlua chunk names.
material.subject: Hot reload of mod data and scripts with rollback to last good state
